evidence: assist.odin:425: `halo := band_width(v, bundles.bundle_tier[bi], int(bundles.bundle_count[bi])) + 6.0 * v.scale // 7.1: the glow hugs the WIDE band (Perkins r2 W-A)`; assist.odin:442: `halo := width * 2.2 + 6.0 * v.scale // 7.1: the candidate halo matches the band scale (Perkins r2 W-A)`. Only caller chain: assist.odin:398 `draw_glow_edge(v, topo, bundles, e.u, e.v, prev.cand_tier)` inside draw_route_glow, called only from app/main.odin:441/445: `rnd.draw_route_glow(&app.view, &app.state.topology, ...)` (gated `app.assist_mode != .Off`). grep of harness/ for route_glow/assist: zero hits; gate 7 (assist_check) asserts preview routing logic, not pixels.

title: N-G on_cancel reorder: unpinned by any test and currently behaviorally inert
evidence: exec.odin:60-65 (Cancel case): `inp.press_swallowed = true` / `// 7.1: the camera-home exit fires AFTER the state mutations so the app` / `// sees the settled selection (Perkins r2 N-G ordering).` / `if inp.on_cancel != nil { inp.on_cancel(inp.user, inp) }`. Sole consumer main.odin:691-694 effect_cancel calls `camera_set_fit(app)`, whose body (main.odin:1139-1143) sets only `app.cam_wx_to = app.view.world_w / 2 ... app.cam_zoom_to = 1.0` — no selection read. No test wires or asserts on_cancel ordering (grep: exec.odin:65, input.odin:75, main.odin:288 only).
detail: The effect-ordering change is asserted nowhere, and today it is unobservable: the only on_cancel consumer reads no selection state. Future consumers could silently regress the ordering.
recommended_fix: When a selection-reading consumer lands, add an input-layer test asserting the hook fires after sel mutations; a recording hook in one parity Cancel scenario suffices.
